The use of `!strip` in options is acceptable for binary packages where symbols may be needed for debugging. All actions are confined to the package directory and serve the legitimate purpose of reformatting a Debian package's contents to fit Arch Linux's filesystem hierarchy. No evidence of data exfiltration, backdoors, or supply-chain tampering is present.
